about: Single source for every SQL file under docs/ops/sql (EXT14, 2026-10-11). Checked by tests/tools/sql-lint.js (npm run sql:lint) and tests/specs/sql-package-ext14.spec.js. Classes: PRODUCTION-READONLY (owner may run; changes nothing), PRODUCTION-CHANGE-DRAFT (owner runs only after approval, one per sitting), ROLLBACK (undoes one change draft), LOCAL-TEST (throwaway local database only), FIXTURE (local schema), OBSOLETE (kept for history, never run). Read-only files are not edited (their SHA-256 prefixes are published in PRODUCTION_READONLY_VERIFICATION_EXT10.md); their metadata lives here.
